remarks: Ski days, village evenings and a place to call your own in every season—9 Stone Ridge brings the Ellicottville lifestyle together. This four-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome offers approximately 1,740 square feet with an inviting layout for gathering and room for overnight guests. A striking floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace anchors the living room, while the open connection to the kitchen and dining area keeps everyone part of the conversation. The kitchen offers generous granite counter space, a tile backsplash and a convenient serving area for après-ski snacks or weekend entertaining. Sliding glass doors off the dining area lead to the deck, ready for morning coffee, summer meals and crisp fall afternoons. An indoor hot tub room with warm wood walls gives you your own place to unwind after a day outdoors, and 2 bedrooms with built-in bunks adds classic ski-house character. Set in the Stone Ridge community near HoliMont and the village, this home puts skiing, local shops, restaurants and entertainment close at hand. Nearby Holiday Valley adds golf, hiking, mountain biking and year-round adventure. Also just a few peddel pushes over to HoliMont's very popular mountain biking trails. From snowy weekends to summer getaways and fall foliage, make this your home base for everything you love about Ellicottville.
